# `acn-ctl` API

The control plane's HTTP/JSON API (SPEC 070), rendered from `crates/acn-ctl/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.1.0). The server's router and that document are built from one route table (CTL-24).

## Routes

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary | Body | Statuses |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/bundles/{run_id}` | `get_bundle` | A bundle, verified: its manifest and files (CTL-22). |  | 200, 400, 404, 409, 421, 500 |
| GET | `/v1/bundles/{run_id}/files/{path}` | `get_bundle_file` | One file the manifest lists, after a hash check (CTL-23). |  | 200, 400, 404, 409, 421, 500 |
| GET | `/v1/endpoints` | `list_endpoints` | The registered endpoints (CTL-30). |  | 200, 421, 500 |
| PUT | `/v1/endpoints/{name}` | `put_endpoint` | Register a named endpoint: a backend and a URL (CTL-30). | `application/json` [`Endpoint`](#endpoint) | 200, 400, 413, 415, 421, 500, 503 |
| DELETE | `/v1/endpoints/{name}` | `delete_endpoint` | Remove a named endpoint (CTL-30). | `application/json` [`Empty`](#empty) | 200, 400, 404, 409, 413, 415, 421, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/openapi.json` | `openapi` | The API's OpenAPI 3.1 document (CTL-24). |  | 200, 421, 500 |
| GET | `/v1/runs` | `list_runs` | Every request's id and state, in submission order (CTL-21). |  | 200, 421, 500 |
| POST | `/v1/runs` | `submit_run` | Submit a run request (CTL-10, CTL-21). | `application/json` [`Submit`](#submit) | 200, 202, 400, 404, 409, 413, 415, 421, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/runs/{request_id}` | `get_run` | A request and its status (CTL-21). |  | 200, 400, 404, 421, 500 |
| POST | `/v1/scenarios` | `store_scenario` | Store a scenario's TOML, named by its BLAKE3 (CTL-20). | `application/toml` string | 200, 400, 413, 415, 421, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/scenarios/{hash}` | `get_scenario` | A stored scenario (CTL-20). |  | 200, 400, 404, 409, 421, 500 |
| POST | `/v1/shutdown` | `shutdown` | Finish the run in progress and stop (CTL-1). | `application/json` [`Empty`](#empty) | 200, 400, 413, 415, 421, 500 |

## Schemas

### Bundle

A bundle, verified (CTL-22).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle_digest` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `files` | array of object | yes |  |
| `manifest` | object | yes | The bundle's manifest (SPEC 010). |
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |
| `run_id` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |

### Empty

`{}`; an empty body is taken as `{}`.

The empty object.

Other fields are refused.

### Endpoint

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `"mockllm"` \| `"openai"` \| `"vllm"` \| `"sglang"` \| `"anthropic"` | yes |  |
| `url` | string | yes | A base URL without credentials, or `acn-mock://loopback` for `mockllm` (HAR-26). |

Other fields are refused.

### Endpoints

The registered endpoints (CTL-30).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoints` | array of object | yes |  |
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |

### Named

The endpoint registered (CTL-30).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |

Done.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |

### Refusal

Every refusal (CTL-2).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

| `code` | string | yes | A stable machine-readable reason. |
| `error` | string | yes |  |
| `ok` | `false` | yes |  |

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |

| `request_id` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `status` | [`Status`](#status) | yes |  |

### Runs

Every request, in submission order (CTL-21).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |
| `runs` | array of object | yes |  |

### Scenario

A stored scenario (CTL-20).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hash` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |
| `toml` | string | yes |  |

### Status

A request's status (CTL-21). `run_id` is set from `running` on; `bundle_digest` and `reused` when `done`; `code` and `error` when `failed`. Times are RFC 3339 UTC.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle_digest` | string |  | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `code` | string |  |  |
| `ended_at` | string |  |  |
| `error` | string |  |  |
| `reused` | boolean |  |  |
| `run_id` | string |  | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `seq` | integer | yes | minimum 0 |
| `started_at` | string |  |  |
| `state` | `"queued"` \| `"running"` \| `"done"` \| `"failed"` | yes |  |
| `submitted_at` | string | yes |  |

### Stored

The scenario stored (CTL-20).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hash` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |

### Submit

A run request (SPEC 070 §2, CTL-10). A `harness` request names `workload`, `backend` and `model` and no `sheet`; a `generator` request names `sheet` and none of those three. Exactly one of `hypothesis` and `seed`. Paths are relative to the workspace root.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arm` | `"treatment"` \| `"control"` | yes |  |
| `backend` | `"mockllm"` \| `"openai"` \| `"vllm"` \| `"sglang"` \| `"anthropic"` |  | harness. |
| `hypothesis` | string |  | The hypothesis file; the seed is derived from it (HYP-9). |
| `kind` | `"harness"` \| `"generator"` | yes |  |
| `mode` | `"sim"` \| `"live"` \| `"netem"` | yes |  |
| `model` | string |  | harness: the model, or the mock profile. |
| `opt` | object |  | Run options, as the CLI's flags; an absent one takes the CLI's default. At most one of `endpoint` and `endpoint_name`. |
| `opt.endpoint` | string |  | A base URL (HAR-25). |
| `opt.endpoint_name` | string |  | pattern `^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$`; A registered endpoint (CTL-30). |
| `opt.max_retries` | integer |  | minimum 0 |
| `opt.request_timeout_ms` | integer |  | minimum 0 |
| `opt.retry_base_ms` | integer |  | minimum 0 |
| `opt.stall_threshold_ms` | number |  | minimum 0 |
| `replicates` | integer | yes | minimum 1 |
| `retry` | boolean |  | Queue a failed request again (CTL-13). |
| `scenario` | one of the forms below |  |  |
| `scenario (form 1).path` | string | yes | A scenario file in the workspace. |
| `scenario (form 2).hash` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`; A stored scenario (CTL-20). |
| `seed` | string |  | pattern `^(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$`; Decimal, at most 2^63 − 1. |
| `sheet` | string |  | generator: the sheet (GEN-1). |
| `vary` | object |  | `name: value`, once per varied parameter. |
| `workload` | string |  | harness: the workload file. |

Other fields are refused.

### Submitted

The request: 202 when new, 200 when it was already known (CTL-21).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |
| `request_id` | string | yes | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `state` | `"queued"` \| `"running"` \| `"done"` \| `"failed"` | yes |  |
